bio: Howdy! (Just kidding!) My name is Claire and I was born and raised in Dallas, Texas. I am a MPP student at Harvard Kennedy School concentrating in International & Global Affairs. I am a Boston College graduate and double majored in Philosophy and International Studies and triple minored in Chinese, Ethics and International Social Justice, and Architecture. I have spent the last 5 years as a public servant in Dallas and now Boston! I am so excited to return to school and welcome you to Harvard! I love to be around people and explore new hobbies! Stop by my room to meet my Crimson Kitties LeCorpussier (Corpy) and Ming Pei (Ming Ming).
